findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 Features in Research Commands

evidence.observation: TODO comments indicating pending Phase 5 implementation for Supabase authorization checking and decision_to_memory integration

proposed_action.description: Implement Phase 5 authorization checking via Supabase and integration with decision_to_memory, or document tracking tickets.

findings.expected_benefit: Completes research command security and memory integration workflows.

findings.title: Unimplemented Quality Anomalies Query in Forecasting

evidence.observation: Hardcoded empty list with TODO: Query quality_anomalies table

proposed_action.description: Replace empty placeholder list with actual query against quality_anomalies table.

findings.expected_benefit: Enables accurate quality anomaly tracking in quality forecasting.

findings.title: Model Router Call Log File Missing

evidence.observation: router_status configures call_log file at /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl but call_log_exists is false

proposed_action.description: Ensure model router properly initializes and writes to its configured call log path.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores model call logging and observability metrics for model routing.

findings.title: Direct LLM API Key Access in Emergency Alert Module

evidence.observation: Direct invocation of call_gemini and call_mistral via os.getenv/dict lookup instead of model router

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert calls to route through the centralized model router instead of direct provider SDK calls.

findings.expected_benefit: Centralizes model usage, fallback handling, and latency/cost tracking through the model router.
